caseName: Ettman v. Federal Life Insurance Co.
caseNameFull: Ettman v. Federal Life Insurance Co.
attorneys: Mr. J. L. London for petitioner. Mr. Wayne Ely for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that the petition for writ of certiorari should be granted.
